channel.title: Anzolo Hope · Practical AI Journal
channel.description: Practical guidance on AI, African business systems and human judgement.

item.title: My AFLCA 2025 award: gratitude, African ambition and the work ahead
item.description: Receiving the Outstanding Entrepreneur of the Year Award is a milestone I treasure—and an encouragement to keep building useful AI and digital systems from Africa.

item.title: Your AI assistant is quoting an old policy. Here is how I would fix it.
item.description: Give every business answer an owner, an effective date and a clear retirement rule, so yesterday’s information does not become today’s promise.

item.title: Your first AI portfolio needs a useful problem, not another impressive demo.
item.description: Build a small enquiry-drafting project with fictional information, a clear test record and an honest account of what you contributed.

item.title: Before you buy another AI tool, let’s find the work that is wearing you out.
item.description: If your customers, payments and follow-ups live in different conversations, start with a clearer process.

item.title: If the AI does not understand your customer, the interface is not finished.
item.description: Local relevance starts with the requests, expressions and corrections your customers actually use.

item.title: Your team finished the AI training. What happens on Monday?
item.description: Turn a learning session into a repeatable workplace habit with one task, one owner and a clear check.

item.title: In the age of AI, the future needs humans. But for what?
item.description: Your value grows when you can frame the problem, check the answer and take responsibility for the decision.

item.title: A convincing AI answer is not permission to act.
item.description: Give an assistant a useful role without letting generated text decide who may change your business records.

item.title: Your business should not lose its memory when the internet drops.
item.description: A practical way to think about saved drafts, retries and reliable work when connectivity changes.
